authority_chain: Kraken Support: Maximum Daily Loss (MDL) Explained

authoritative_corrections.profit_target: Kraken support states the evaluation passes when account equity reaches the plan target in real time, including unrealized PnL and after fees.
authoritative_corrections.mdl: Kraken support states MDL is 3% below account balance at 00:30 UTC; total equity is monitored intraday and realized/unrealized PnL, commissions and margin funding count.

implementation_clarification.synchronized_1m_close_target: A synchronized 1m-close equity at or above target is a confirmed proxy target event.
implementation_clarification.intraminute_target_upper_bound: For each minute, the sum of long-position values at each symbol's 1m high is only an upper bound because cross-symbol highs may not be synchronous. If this upper bound could have reached target while synchronized close did not, record TARGET_UPPER_BOUND_POSSIBLE but do not call a pass.
implementation_clarification.persistence: TARGET_UPPER_BOUND_POSSIBLE persists for that scenario until a confirmed synchronized-close target or a confirmed synchronized-close breach/period end.
implementation_clarification.false_breach_guard: If a later synchronized-close MDL/MDD breach occurs after any earlier TARGET_UPPER_BOUND_POSSIBLE event, classification is AMBIGUITY_MATERIAL rather than OBVIOUS_PROXY_BREACH, because a real-time target may have been reached earlier inside a minute.
implementation_clarification.false_no_decision_guard: If the replay ends without confirmed close target/breach but a TARGET_UPPER_BOUND_POSSIBLE occurred, classification is AMBIGUITY_MATERIAL rather than PROXY_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY_NO_DECISION.
implementation_clarification.low_bound_rule: The existing lower-bound rule is unchanged: aggregate 1m lows are a conservative mathematical lower bound only. Prior lower-bound floor crossing makes a later confirmed close target AMBIGUITY_MATERIAL; it cannot alone prove breach.
implementation_clarification.no_parameter_change: No plan, risk value, execution cost, carry envelope, symbol, date, setup rule, or threshold is changed by this clarification.

scientific_reason: This is an implementation-correctness clarification required by the already-frozen real-time-equity target rule. It prevents false certainty in either direction and is frozen before opening the 1m ambiguity-envelope outcomes.
